changelog:
- Initial release of the "sleep" skill for responding when users mention rest, bedtime, or sleep-related topics.
- Concise, warm send-off messages when users indicate they're going to rest or end the conversation.
- Provides basic, practical sleep hygiene advice for common questions about sleep and routines, with clear boundaries (not medical advice).
- Avoids detailed technical or medical guidance, long essays, or continuing conversation after "good night."
- Recognizes context to avoid triggering on programming-related mentions of "sleep."
